claims.text: Most reviewers love the product, praising the volume and body it adds, especially for fine or short hair.
The auto-spin feature is widely appreciated for making styling easier than a round brush and blow dryer, and several note it doesn't tangle hair when used correctly.
A few reviewers report serious problems, including the brush stopping when it meets hair and receiving two identical brush attachments instead of the sizes advertised.
Some users find the device large or intimidating at first and note a learning curve before getting the hang of it.
Reviewers mention the heat settings run warm to hot, so care is needed with the hottest setting.
